purpose: Prevent duplicate validation and operator execution when M3-C-G work moves across chats, PR metadata states, or operator sessions.

active_base.title: M3-C-F bounded lifecycle writer activation-gate design

non_invalidators: PR body, title, comment, review, Draft, or Ready metadata change
reporting-only reuse of the pinned prerequisite chain
invalidators: a new M3-C-G tree or exact head requiring its own validation
artifact loss, corruption, expiry without retained immutable copy, or SHA-256 mismatch
validation workflow, pinned dependency, or test-scope change
base ancestry no longer containing the pinned merge SHA
new_tree_rule: M3-C-G receives one new exact-head validation only for its final forward-registered tree. Discovery and registration-only heads are not merge evidence; full suite must run once on the final registered exact head.
next_chat_rule: Inspect this pin and EXACT_HEAD_VALIDATION_REUSE_LEDGER.json before scheduling tests or operator commands. Reuse the immutable prerequisite evidence when policy conditions still match.
